title: BattINFO Electrode Instance
description: A physical electrode batch (coated web, sheet or punched discs) realizing an electrode-spec. The 'instance' half of the electrode-spec + electrode pair; as-built actuals live in the open 'property' map, never in a closed vocabulary.

schema_version.description: Version of the record schema this document conforms to (semantic versioning); stamped by the library on save.

electrode_spec_id.description: Canonical IRI of the electrode-spec this batch realizes. Required: a built electrode without a design is not describable.

lot_id.description: Producer / supplier lot number for a purchased electrode.

batch_id.description: Coating batch label (e.g. 'Si-AQ-1'). Together with the spec IRI this is the batch's identity — the IRI is minted from the pair.

supplier.description: Supplier or vendor the item was sourced from.

manufactured_at.description: Date this batch was coated / built.

received_date.description: Date a purchased batch was received.

amount.description: Quantity of this batch on hand or consumed (e.g. coated area in cm2, web length in m, mass in g).

count.description: Number of discrete pieces in this batch (e.g. punched discs).

storage.description: Storage conditions for this batch (e.g. 'argon glovebox', 'dry room, -40 degC dew point').

datasets.description: Characterization datasets for this batch (thickness maps, SEM, adhesion, half-cell checks, ...).

property.description: As-built batch actuals — measured loading, measured calendered thickness, measured porosity, disc diameter, disc mass. An open snake_case map: whatever this batch was actually measured for is recordable without a schema change.

provenance.description: Where the information in this record came from: source type, file or URL, citation, and retrieval time.

contributor.description: People who contributed this record to the platform (attribution/provenance). Each is a schema:Person; an ORCID may be given in same_as. Stamped by ws.save.

license.description: License under which this record is released, as an SPDX identifier (e.g. "cc-by-4.0") or a URL. Stamped from the workspace default (ws.license) and emitted as dcterms:license in JSON-LD.

ComponentIri.description: Canonical BattINFO IRI in the electrode/ namespace (https://w3id.org/battinfo/electrode/xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx).

ShortId.description: Short human-friendly identifier derived from the record IRI (Crockford base32, 6-16 characters).

UnixTime.description: Unix timestamp in whole seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z.

oneOf.description: ISO 8601 calendar date string: YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD.

FlexDate.description: Date as an ISO 8601 string (YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD) or a Unix timestamp in seconds.

DatasetIri.description: Canonical BattINFO IRI in the dataset/ namespace (https://w3id.org/battinfo/dataset/xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx).

id.description: Canonical IRI of the linked dataset record.

role.description: Role of the linked dataset as a whole relative to this record (record level; the per-file role lives on the dataset's distribution entries).

DatasetLink.description: Link to a dataset record, with the role the dataset plays for this record.

OrganizationIri.description: Canonical BattINFO IRI in the organization/ namespace (https://w3id.org/battinfo/organization/xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx).

id.description: Canonical BattINFO organization IRI linking this party to its organization record.

Organization.description: An organization referenced by name, with an optional canonical BattINFO organization IRI.

OrgRef.description: An organization, as either a plain name string or a structured Organization object that can carry a canonical organization IRI.

Funding.description: Funding project (grant) under which the record was produced. Maps to schema:funding / schema:Grant in JSON-LD.

source_type.description: Kind of source this record was created from.

source_name.description: Human-readable name of the source (document title, instrument, lab, or system).

source_file.description: Filename or path of the source file, when the record was derived from a file.

source_url.description: URL of the source document or landing page, when available.

citation.description: Resolvable citation target to use for attribution, typically a DOI URL.

citation_doi.description: DOI of the source publication (bare '10.xxxx/...' form). Prefer provenance.citation with a DOI resolver URL.

retrieved_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch, UTC) when the source was retrieved or the record was captured.

battinfo_version.description: Version of the battinfo library that wrote this record (semantic versioning); stamped on save.

Provenance.description: Where the information in this record came from: source type, file or URL, citation, and retrieval time.
